Questions, answered

How does the BIODANCE collagen mask work?

It is a hydrogel sheet soaked in collagen essence. As the skin absorbs the essence over several hours, the mask turns transparent — that is the sign it has done its work.

Do you sleep in the mask?

You can — it is designed for overnight wear. If she prefers, a 3–4 hour session before bed gives a similar glow.

Is it a good stocking stuffer?

One of the best beauty ones this year: small, light, individually wrapped, and it is the mask people have actually seen all over their feeds.

Is it suitable for sensitive skin?

As with any new skincare, a patch test on the jawline first is the sensible move, especially for very sensitive skin.
